integrity: Exact finite-field and binary-rank computations are reproducible from bundled Python stdlib code. No independent audit or independent validation has taken place.
scientific_limitations: Only the m=6 member is identified; the affine line code, incidence rank and automorphism group were already known in the older geometric literature. An unindexed statement of this exact cross-description equivalence remains a literature risk.
title: Affine-line realization of the length-64 extended \(C_{1,5}\) code
